    first = invoke(app, store, 'prepare', ('a', 'one'))

    assert invoke(app, store, 'commit', first) == 'committed'

item.text: The baseline only supports reads and hard-conflicts every commit. I’m reading the fixture contracts now to see the intended prepare token shape and store semantics before changing it.

The store exposes per-record revisions and a `commit(group, actor)` method. I’m going to make `prepare` capture the chosen row revision, then make `commit` re-check the current whole-store invariant after the proposed change so independent safe operations can both commit while unsafe stale ones still conflict.
The core change is in place. I’m running the public tests now, then I’ll do a quick targeted check for same-record stale conflict behavior since that is the risky concurrency case.
